description: No ladder profile requires a control for which no implementation has an engine.
note: Requiring AMLAssessment at MUST_EXERCISE would make aegs-2 look considerably more serious and would make it unsatisfiable -- so every implementation would claim aegs-1, the higher level would go unused, and the specification would have gained a decoration. Requiring the impossible moves the real bar DOWN. The input names the three ladder profiles explicitly rather than scanning every profile, and that is now load-bearing: PROF-6a permits a VERTICAL profile to require an engineless control, and stablecoin-1 does. Scanning all profiles here would assert something the standard no longer claims.
